source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    s.name AS SourceSchema,
    t.name AS SourceTable,
    t.temporal_type_desc AS TableType,

    pk.PrimaryKeyColumns,

    CASE
        WHEN t.temporal_type_desc =
             'SYSTEM_VERSIONED_TEMPORAL_TABLE'
            THEN CAST(1 AS bit)

        WHEN t.temporal_type_desc = 'HISTORY_TABLE'
            THEN CAST(1 AS bit)

        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.columns AS wc
            WHERE wc.object_id = t.object_id
              AND wc.name = 'LastEditedWhen'
        )
            THEN CAST(1 AS bit)

        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.columns AS wc
            WHERE wc.object_id = t.object_id
              AND wc.name = 'RecordedWhen'
        )
            THEN CAST(1 AS bit)

        ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)
    END AS IncrementalEnabled,

    CASE
        WHEN t.temporal_type_desc =
             'SYSTEM_VERSIONED_TEMPORAL_TABLE'
            THEN 'TEMPORAL_CURRENT_UPSERT'

        WHEN t.temporal_type_desc = 'HISTORY_TABLE'
            THEN 'TEMPORAL_HISTORY_APPEND'

        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.columns AS wc
            WHERE wc.object_id = t.object_id
              AND wc.name = 'LastEditedWhen'
        )
            THEN 'WATERMARK_UPSERT'

        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.columns AS wc
            WHERE wc.object_id = t.object_id
              AND wc.name = 'RecordedWhen'
        )
            THEN 'WATERMARK_APPEND'

        ELSE 'FULL_RELOAD'
    END AS IncrementalMethod,

    CASE
        WHEN t.temporal_type_desc =
             'SYSTEM_VERSIONED_TEMPORAL_TABLE'
            THEN 'ValidFrom'

        WHEN t.temporal_type_desc = 'HISTORY_TABLE'
            THEN 'ValidTo'

        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.columns AS wc
            WHERE wc.object_id = t.object_id
              AND wc.name = 'LastEditedWhen'
        )
            THEN 'LastEditedWhen'

        WHEN EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.columns AS wc
            WHERE wc.object_id = t.object_id
              AND wc.name = 'RecordedWhen'
        )
            THEN 'RecordedWhen'

        ELSE NULL
    END AS WatermarkColumn,

    CASE
        WHEN t.temporal_type_desc = 'HISTORY_TABLE'
            THEN 'READY_HISTORY_PARENT_KEY_REQUIRED'

        WHEN pk.PrimaryKeyColumns IS NULL
            THEN 'REVIEW_PRIMARY_KEY'

        WHEN
        (
            t.temporal_type_desc =
                'SYSTEM_VERSIONED_TEMPORAL_TABLE'
            OR EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM sys.columns AS wc
                WHERE wc.object_id = t.object_id
                  AND wc.name IN
                  (
                      'LastEditedWhen',
                      'RecordedWhen'
                  )
            )
        )
            THEN 'READY_FOR_INCREMENTAL'

        ELSE 'FULL_RELOAD_ONLY'
    END AS ConfigStatus

FROM sys.tables AS t

JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id

OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT
        STRING_AGG(
            CAST(pk_column.name AS nvarchar(max)),
            ','
        ) WITHIN GROUP
        (
            ORDER BY index_column.key_ordinal
        ) AS PrimaryKeyColumns

    FROM sys.indexes AS primary_index

    JOIN sys.index_columns AS index_column
        ON index_column.object_id =
           primary_index.object_id
       AND index_column.index_id =
           primary_index.index_id

    JOIN sys.columns AS pk_column
        ON pk_column.object_id =
           index_column.object_id
       AND pk_column.column_id =
           index_column.column_id

    WHERE primary_index.object_id = t.object_id
      AND primary_index.is_primary_key = 1
) AS pk

WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0
  AND s.name IN
  (
      'Application',
      'Purchasing',
      'Sales',
      'Warehouse'
  )

ORDER BY
    s.name,
    t.name;
